name: Demario
qaNote: Reference visually inspected. Preserve blue bib and red trousers, cap and existing fist insignias. Review blue-highlight keying, mushroom continuity, title and launch readability.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact muscular dark-skinned man with short black chin beard, red cap with white fist emblem, white tank, bright royal-blue overall bib, red work trousers and tan heavy work boots. Preserve this unusual color arrangement and all fist emblems.
0.0–0.7s: full-body low-angle anticipation. He flicks one tiny red-and-cream spotted mushroom up from his palm, eyes following it; his boots coil into an exaggerated squat.
0.7–2.5s: a thunderous upward boot-kick sends that SAME mushroom thirty feet upward. Camera rockets backward and tilts up: the mushroom rapidly expands into a gigantic red-and-cream umbrella, then rebounds toward him like a meteor. He launches after it and punches beneath its stem, blasting it toward the camera with a huge warm-gold, black-edged starburst and a deep BOOM. Keep cyan visible around the mushroom silhouette; no actual ground or scenery.
2.5–3.5s: snap back to his three-quarter hero view as the mushroom magically compresses back to palm-size and lands neatly in his outstretched hand. Exact title MUSHROOM DELIVERY slams into the lower-middle composition, below his face, on the landing impact.
3.5–5.0s: he smugly offers the mushroom to the viewer like a perfectly delivered package; its delayed bounce tips his cap over one eye. He catches the brim with his free hand and holds an annoyed heroic pose. Keep one mushroom only, readable silhouette and stable text. SFX: spring-loaded squeak, giant rising rush, boot thump, massive punch boom, tiny delivery ding and soft hat tap.

name: Divorced Dad
qaNote: Reference visually inspected. Keep gray-haired bearded dad, navy jacket, polo, jeans, trainers, cup and fist key fob. Review seatbelt continuity, hand/prop count and blue denim under chroma key.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact tired, gray-haired, gray-bearded middle-aged man, navy zip jacket over pale-gray polo, blue jeans, white chunky running shoes, steel travel mug and keys with a small fist-emblem fob. No other person or child appears; his rescue target is a small stylized gold ally token, an inanimate shield-shaped game emblem.
0.0–0.7s: establish whole dad rushing in, travel mug held upright, fumbling his keys. He clicks the car fob with an absurdly determined face; a black seatbelt with a silver buckle whips out from the key fob like a superhero rescue cable.
0.7–2.5s: whip-pan and huge pullback follow the seatbelt thirty feet through cyan. It loops safely around the distant gold ally token and retracts like a winch. Dad skids backward in midair, trainers flailing, but catches the token against his free forearm. The belt coils into a gigantic circular protective cage around both dad and token, snapping its buckle shut with a thunderous metallic CLACK and a warm orange shock ring. No car interior, road, floor or landscape.
2.5–3.5s: camera snaps toward his proud exhausted face, then settles wide enough to show the protective belt loop and both feet. Exact title MY WEEKEND slams below his head as he plants a heroic pose in the cyan void.
3.5–5.0s: the cage contracts to a neat silver-buckled shield around the token tucked securely at his side. He finally sips the coffee; one tiny delayed splash lands on his forehead. He gives the viewer a deadpan stare while keeping the rescued token safe. Stable title. SFX: fob chirp, belt zip, immense winch rush, buckle CLACK, sneaker squeak and final tiny coffee plop; no voice.

name: DMV Worker
qaNote: Reference visually inspected. Preserve woman, braided bun, rectangular glasses, blue uniform and heavy boots. Keep existing small uniform markings only; move title is sole new display text. Review paper edges and freeze impact.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact stern brown-skinned woman with large braided bun, rectangular black glasses, gold hoop earrings, blue short-sleeve uniform shirt, black cargo trousers, black heavy work shoes, keys and ID, holding forms and a chunky red-and-black rubber stamp. Keep small existing uniform labels unobtrusive; invent no extra signage or written captions. Paperwork shows abstract form lines, not readable prose.
0.0–0.7s: establish full body. She peers over her glasses, raises one index finger commanding wait, then flicks one blank cream queue ticket from the stack.
0.7–2.5s: camera races backward as that ticket unspools into an enormous corkscrew of cream paper, whipping thirty feet into depth and gathering her loose forms into a roaring bureaucratic tornado. A dark ink-outlined gold fist-shaped GAME TOKEN, not a person, gets harmlessly caught at its center. She pulls back the stamp like a judge about to end the universe; extreme perspective makes it colossal. One stamping blow snaps the paper tornado and token into a frozen accordion-shaped queue, with an explosive red-orange impact star and a single resonant desk-slam BOOM. All paper shapes are foreground objects with cyan visible between coils, never a full background sheet or panel.
2.5–3.5s: snap-zoom to her bored face, reveal the towering motionless queue beside her. Exact title TAKE A NUMBER slams below her face in the established comic treatment.
3.5–5.0s: everything in the queue remains frozen while she slowly straightens her glasses with a single finger. One late sheet tries to drift free; she taps it with the stamp without looking and it freezes instantly. Hero composition, visible boots, stable text. SFX: ticket tear, roaring paper cyclone, massive stamp boom, sudden silence, tiny second stamp click; no speech.

name: Dominican Phone Salesman
qaNote: Reference visually inspected. Preserve exact salesman, blue polo with Dominican flag patch, cream trousers, brown loafers, jewelry, three phones. Review portal body continuity, fingers, flag fidelity and title spelling.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact smiling brown-skinned man with short black curls, neat fade haircut and shaped goatee, royal-blue polo with small Dominican flag patch, gold chain and stud earrings, cream trousers, brown belt and polished brown loafers. Preserve his three black, cream and royal-blue smartphones. No company logos or extra readable UI text.
0.0–0.7s: full-body salesman leans confidently toward camera and fans the three phones. One fast thumb swipe flings them outward like playing cards.
0.7–2.5s: the three phones enlarge into enormous separate floating portal-shaped devices arranged thirty feet apart in depth, their centers pure cyan and their solid black/gold rims clearly outlined. Camera whip-tracks him as he launches feet-first through the nearest device, vanishes cleanly into its cyan screen and bursts from the farthest device with a huge accelerating gold signal-ring shockwave. His body stays anatomically coherent and never duplicates. He brakes in a spectacular loafers-first slide through the cyan void as four enormous gold signal bars explode upward in a rising staircase beside him, one dominant final impact, no physical floor.
2.5–3.5s: the camera snap-zooms from the towering bars to his confident grin. The devices shrink back into three ordinary phones, landing neatly fanned in his hand. Exact title SWITCH CARRIERS slams across the lower-middle frame below his face.
3.5–5.0s: settle into a readable full-body sales pose. He presents the three phones and winks; the smallest gold signal bar gives one belated enormous pulse that briefly ruffles his collar, but his smile never slips. Keep backing pure cyan and title stable. SFX: swipe clicks, escalating electric portal zip, rapid air rush, huge bass impact, rubbery shoe squeak and one late notification ping. No voice or music.
